content: Offline support is not an installability requirement (MDN: many PWAs use service workers for offline but it is not required to be installable). However a non-empty service worker with a fetch handler is still required for Chrome to fire the automatic install prompt (developer.chrome.com 2023-12). A tiny cache-first SW (~20 lines) satisfies the prompt and gives genuine offline reading of visited pages - worthwhile for a child on the go.
